blocks.text: Parameters that move together, found in the data: spearman correlation, complete linkage, cut at |r| ≥ 0.8, and a pair needs at least 8 shared batches before its correlation counts as evidence. Action: **linear**. One member of each group was kept and the others replaced by what is left of them once the retained ones are accounted for.

Residualising does not preserve everything the group held, and it does not make the columns independent: each regression is fitted on the rows where all its inputs are present, so columns with different gaps are only orthogonal there, and least-squares orthogonality is not zero rank correlation.

blocks.note: An empty correlation or VIF cell is undefined — too few complete rows to compute it — which is not the same as zero or as infinite. VIF is computed on the rows where every member is present, and that count is the last column.
